change_summary: Align local Agent import guidance with the shipped metadata-only inventory, exact-selection freeze, and selected-body parsing boundary without expanding upload consent.

canonical_skill.note: The local-import Skill now keeps discovery body-blind, freezes exact selected session references before parsing, and preserves the existing explicit upload-consent boundary.

server_contract.note: The server advertises Skill release 1.7.64 while retaining collaboration contract 2026-09-17.4 and its existing compatibility boundary.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.64; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.35 and are compatible with the unchanged collaboration contract.

help_center.note: Public Help remains compatible because the release narrows local parsing stages without changing the remote MCP connection or installation flow.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports Skill 1.7.64 and contract 2026-09-17.4 so installed hosts can detect freshness accurately without expanding write authority.

harness_and_mainline.note: The logbook records why changed local-import guidance requires a new immutable package version and keeps the existing contract revision.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Backend and frontend package-contract tests assert the new immutable release number, generated source tag and SessionStart freshness metadata.
